svg.aria-label: What to check next. Nov 12: L&C Bio's 30.4 million bonus shares list; the share count doubles to 61.1 million; By Nov 14: 3Q reports: the cause of PharmaResearch's ₩18.5B non-operating loss; L&C Bio's 3Q results; Oct–Dec: L&C Bio plants 3 and 4 scheduled (start not yet confirmed); capacity limits Re2O growth; By end-2026: MFDS policy study on human-tissue aesthetic products; L&C Bio's China goodwill test; 2027: Re2O U.S. supply starts at a $7.2M minimum; tourist VAT-refund bills sit in the Assembly; ~2028: Rejuran class III approval in China (broker expectation); PharmaResearch capacity build-out
svg.text: Dated events that can change the numbers above
L&C Bio's 30.4 million bonus shares list; the share count doubles to 61.1 million
3Q reports: the cause of PharmaResearch's ₩18.5B non-operating loss; L&C Bio's 3Q results
L&C Bio plants 3 and 4 scheduled (start not yet confirmed); capacity limits Re2O growth
MFDS policy study on human-tissue aesthetic products; L&C Bio's China goodwill test
Re2O U.S. supply starts at a $7.2M minimum; tourist VAT-refund bills sit in the Assembly
Rejuran class III approval in China (broker expectation); PharmaResearch capacity build-out
L&C Bio's own prospectus says a further impairment of the Kunshan goodwill at end-2026 is likely. It would be non-cash.
